company.name: Biostate AI
company.shortDescription: Biostate AI is a company focused on providing AI-powered solutions for the life sciences and healthcare industries.
company.description: Biostate AI is a company focused on providing AI-powered solutions for the life sciences and healthcare industries. The company develops data-driven tools to optimize medical research, drug discovery, and clinical trials. By leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning, Biostate AI aims to streamline complex processes and improve decision-making. Their products include platforms for predictive analytics, data integration, and patient recruitment, which help organizations enhance efficiency and accuracy in medical and clinical operations. Through their innovations, Biostate AI supports the advancement of healthcare through smarter technology applications.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Biostate AI combines K-Dense AI with N-Act AI.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $12,000,000, or 75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $22,392,627 to $62,882,481, a 2.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
